title: I made a phone game in 20 languages with its own built-in game engine, you can make your own games and see the code in Python, and the whole thing is smaller than one photo on your phone
author: EmberGateDev
selftext:
Been building this one for a while and its finally at a point where im proud of it. Its called Console Climb.  
You start in a closet with a cheap handheld and beat mini games to earn money. That money buys newer consoles and the graphics upgrade with every one, it starts at 4 shades of green and goes all the way up to full 3D with lighting. There are 70+ mini games, platformers, racers, shooters, puzzles, fighting, rhythm and more.  
Whats inside:

* its own game engine and its own coding language (ForgeScript), so players can build their own games and publish them for everyone else to play
* you can view your game's code as Python, JavaScript or C++
* a story where a company called CloudCorp buys up every console in the world until the apocalypse hits and you have to survive
* limited edition console skins with real serial numbers, only so many exist worldwide
* design your own console
* streaming, a room you upgrade, a town, conventions to sell collectibles
* 20 languages

The whole download is about 1/10th the size of one photo on your phone.  
Learned a ton building this one, happy to answer questions about how I put it together. Would love honest feedback too, especially on the first 10 minutes and whether the difficulty feels right.
